# Resolve species names

Resolve species in all datasets to GBIF accepted names using the package taxize:

## Species in sensitivity data

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
length(slopes_all_species$Species) # 187
# Due to gna_verifier only being able to handle 50 names at once subsetting
spp1 <- slopes_all_species$Species[1:50]
spp2 <- slopes_all_species$Species[51:100]
spp3 <- slopes_all_species$Species[101:150]
spp4 <- slopes_all_species$Species[151:187]

# Getting current canonical names
resolved_1 <- gna_verifier(spp1, data_sources = 11) # 11 = GBIF Backbone Taxonomy
resolved_2 <- gna_verifier(spp2, data_sources = 11)
resolved_3 <- gna_verifier(spp3, data_sources = 11)
resolved_4 <- gna_verifier(spp4, data_sources = 11)

# Combining all of the names
all_resolved <- rbind(resolved_1, resolved_2, resolved_3, resolved_4)

# Add to sp_list
slopes_all_species_resolved <- slopes_all_species %>%
  cbind(., all_resolved$currentCanonicalFull) %>%
  rename(name_res = `all_resolved$currentCanonicalFull`)
slopes_all_resolved <- slopes_all %>%
  left_join(slopes_all_species_resolved)
```

## Species in  Red List data

Resolve species (`sPlot concept unified`) to GBIF accepted names:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
length(unique(redlist$`sPlot concept unified`)) # 21096
# Due to gna_verifier only being able to handle 50 names at once subsetting
# Chunk the names into groups of <= 50
chunk_size <- 50
chunks <- split(unique(redlist$`sPlot concept unified`), 
                ceiling(seq_along(unique(redlist$`sPlot concept unified`)) / 
                          chunk_size))

# Helper to resolve one chunk using GBIF Backbone (data_sources = 11)
resolve_chunk_tbl <- function(x) {
  gna_verifier(
    names = x,
    data_sources = 11,       # GBIF Backbone Taxonomy
    all_matches = FALSE,     # best match only
    output_type = "table"
  )
}

# Try table output first
resolved_tbl <- tryCatch(
  {
    map(chunks, resolve_chunk_tbl) %>% bind_rows()
  },
  error = function(e) NULL
)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
resolved_tbl2 <- resolved_tbl %>%
  rename(
    rl_name_clean = submittedName,           
    name_res = currentCanonicalFull
  ) %>%
  # If duplicates exist in resolved_tbl (same submitted name multiple times),
  # keep the first/best one:
  distinct(rl_name_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)

redlist_with_clean <- redlist %>%
  mutate(
    rl_name_raw   = `sPlot concept unified`,
    rl_name_clean = str_squish(rl_name_raw)
  )

# Left-join: keep ALL rows from redlist
redlist_resolved <- redlist_with_clean %>%
  left_join(resolved_tbl2 %>%
              select(rl_name_clean, name_res), 
            by = "rl_name_clean")
```

## Species in Ellenberg tendency of change data


```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
length(unique(ellenberg$Art)) # 2791
# Due to gna_verifier only being able to handle 50 names at once subsetting
# Chunk the names into groups of <= 50
chunks <- split(unique(ellenberg$Art), 
                ceiling(seq_along(unique(ellenberg$Art)) / 
                          chunk_size))
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE, message=FALSE}
resolved_tbl_list <- vector("list", length(chunks))
for (i in seq_along(chunks)) {
  cat("Resolving chunk", i, "of", length(chunks), 
      " (n =", length(chunks[[i]]), ")\n")
  res <- try(resolve_chunk_tbl(chunks[[i]]), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    cat("Chunk", i, "failed with:\n", attr(res, "condition")$message, "\n")
    break
  }
  resolved_tbl_list[[i]] <- res
}
resolved_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(resolved_tbl_list)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
resolved_tbl2 <- resolved_tbl %>%
  rename(
    ellenberg_name_clean = submittedName,           
    name_res = currentCanonicalFull
  ) %>%
  # If duplicates exist in resolved_tbl (same submitted name multiple times),
  # keep the first/best one:
  distinct(ellenberg_name_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)

ellenberg_with_clean <- ellenberg %>%
  mutate(
    ellenberg_name_raw   = Art,
    ellenberg_name_clean = str_squish(ellenberg_name_raw)
  )

# Left-join: keep ALL rows from ellenberg
ellenberg_resolved <- ellenberg_with_clean %>%
  left_join(resolved_tbl2 %>%
              select(ellenberg_name_clean, name_res), 
            by = "ellenberg_name_clean") %>% select(-Art, -ellenberg_name_raw,
                                                    -ellenberg_name_clean)
```

# Create occurrence matrix

Occurrence matrices are created using the package rgbif. 

## Get countries form RL

Get vector of ISO3 codes.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Change iso3 code for Kosovo
redlist <- redlist %>%
  mutate(ISO3_Code = ifelse(ISO3_Code == "KOS", "XKX", ISO3_Code))
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
ISO3_Codes <- redlist %>%
  distinct(ISO3_Code) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ISO3_Code)) %>%
  pull(ISO3_Code)
```

## Build occurrence matrix

Build the species × country occurrence matrix with rgbif.

Settings:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
options(timeout = 180)                      # allow slower responses
options(future.rng.onMisuse = "ignore")     # silence RNG warning when seed is set

workers <- 4
future::plan(multisession, workers = workers)
```

Helper functions:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

retry <- function(expr_fun, tries = 3L, base_wait = 0.7) {

  for (i in seq_len(tries)) {

    out <- try(expr_fun(), silent = TRUE)

    if (!inherits(out, "try-error")) {
      return(out)
    }

    Sys.sleep(base_wait * (2^(i - 1)))
  }

  out
}
```

Query GBIF once per species:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
get_species_country_counts <- function(sp) {

  require(rgbif)
  require(dplyr)
  require(tibble)

  res <- retry(
    function() {

      rgbif::occ_search(
        scientificName = sp,
        limit = 0,
        facet = "country",
        facetLimit = 300
      )

    }
  )

  if (inherits(res, "try-error") ||
      is.null(res$facets) ||
      length(res$facets) == 0) {

    return(
      tibble(
        species = sp,
        iso2 = character(),
        count = integer(),
        status = character()
      )
    )
  }

  country_tbl <- res$facets$country

  if (is.null(country_tbl) || nrow(country_tbl) == 0) {

    return(
      tibble(
        species = sp,
        iso2 = character(),
        count = integer(),
        status = character()
      )
    )
  }

  tibble(
    species = sp,
    iso2 = country_tbl$name,
    count = country_tbl$count,
    status = "ok"
  )
}
```

Parallel querying:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Get species vector
sp_vec <- unique(slopes_all_species_resolved$name_res)

pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "GBIF species [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)",
  total = length(sp_vec),
  clear = FALSE
)

results_list <- future_map(
  sp_vec,
  function(sp) {

    out <- get_species_country_counts(sp)

    pb$tick()

    out

  },
  .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
)

results <- bind_rows(results_list)
```

Convert ISO2 to ISO3. GBIF returns country codes as ISO2.

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    iso3 = countrycode(
      iso2,
      origin = "iso2c",
      destination = "iso3c"
    )
  )
```

Keep Kosovo, discard unknown countries:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    iso3 = countrycode(
      iso2,
      origin = "iso2c",
      destination = "iso3c",
      custom_match = c(
        XK = "XKX",  # Kosovo
        ZZ = NA      # Unknown country
      )
    )
  )
```

## Select only countries in RL

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
results <- results %>%
  filter(iso3 %in% ISO3_Codes) %>%
  # Discard unknown countries
  filter(!is.na(iso3))
```

Build complete species × country matrix:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
occurrence_matrix <- results %>%
  select(species, iso3, count) %>%
  group_by(species, iso3) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(
    species = sp_vec,
    iso3 = ISO3_Codes,
    fill = list(count = 0)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = iso3,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

Presence/ABsence matrix:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
occ_matrix_pa <- results %>%
  mutate(presence = 1L) %>%
  select(species, iso3, presence) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  complete(
    species = sp_vec,
    iso3 = ISO3_Codes,
    fill = list(presence = 0L)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = iso3,
    values_from = presence,
    values_fill = 0L
  )
```

# Matching Phenobs - MOTIVATE Red List data

Do not only use the RL of the countries where we have our botanical gardens, instead use the RL from all available countries in Europe!

Try to match the full PhenObs spp list with the RL to see how many species are there in each category for each country.

## Join RL and spp list in sensitivity data from PhenObs

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Change iso3 code for Kosovo
redlist_resolved <- redlist_resolved %>%
  mutate(ISO3_Code = ifelse(ISO3_Code == "KOS", "XKX", ISO3_Code))

redlist_phenobs <- tibble(slopes_all_species_resolved %>% select(name_res)) %>%
  left_join(redlist_resolved) %>%
  # Keep columns that I think I will use
  select(name_res, Redlist_cat, Threat, Country, Publ_year, ISO3_Code) %>%
  # Remove those with Threat == NA (not present in any red list)
  filter(!is.na(Threat))
redlist_phenobs
```

## Data prep RL

```{r}
# Order from most severe -> least severe
severity_order <- c(
  "EX", "EW", "REW", "RE",
  "PEX", "PE",
  "CR", "EN", "VU", "R", "threatened",
  "NT", "LC",
  "DD", "NE", "WL"
)

# Remove info from Russia!
redlist_phenobs <- redlist_phenobs %>%
  filter(ISO3_Code != "RUS")

redlist_phenobs_final <- redlist_phenobs %>%
  
  group_by(name_res, ISO3_Code) %>%
  
  slice({

    # Case 1: all publication years are NA (e.g. Russia)
    if (all(is.na(Publ_year))) {

      # Majority Threat
      threat_counts <- table(Threat)
      max_count <- max(threat_counts)

      winning_threats <- names(threat_counts)[
        threat_counts == max_count
      ]

      # No tie -> keep the most severe RL category
      # within the winning Threat
      if (length(winning_threats) == 1) {

        candidate_rows <- which(
          Threat == winning_threats
        )

      } else {

        # Tie -> consider all tied Threat groups
        candidate_rows <- which(
          Threat %in% winning_threats
        )
      }

      candidate_rows[
        which.min(
          match(
            Redlist_cat[candidate_rows],
            severity_order
          )
        )
      ]

    } else {

      # Case 2: publication years available

      latest_year <- max(Publ_year, na.rm = TRUE)

      latest_rows <- which(
        Publ_year == latest_year
      )

      # ALWAYS choose the most severe RL category
      # among records from the latest year

      latest_rows[
        which.min(
          match(
            Redlist_cat[latest_rows],
            severity_order
          )
        )
      ]
    }

  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```

Verify that there is only one record per species and country:

```{r}
redlist_phenobs_final %>% group_by(name_res, ISO3_Code) %>% filter(n() > 1)
```

Set those where Threat is not_evaluated_dd as not_threatened:

```{r}
redlist_phenobs_final <- redlist_phenobs_final %>%
   mutate(Threat = case_when(Threat == "not_evaluated_dd" ~ "not_threatened",
                             TRUE ~ Threat))
```

# Join occurrence data and Red List data 

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
redlist_phenobs_final_occ <- 
  # Here, all 187 species are included
  occ_matrix_pa %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:43), names_to = "iso3", values_to = "occurrence") %>%
  # Here, only the species included in red lists in ANY country (i.e. 162 spp)
  # are included
  left_join(redlist_phenobs_final, by = c("species" = "name_res",
                                        "iso3" = "ISO3_Code")) %>%
  # Remove unneded columns
  select(-Redlist_cat, -Country, -Publ_year) %>%
  # Rename
  rename(country = iso3, threat = Threat) %>%
  # Order columns
  select(species, country, occurrence, threat) %>%
  # Set those where threat is NA as not_threatened
  mutate(threat = case_when(
    is.na(threat) ~ "not_threatened",
    TRUE ~ threat
  ))
```

Change occurrence from 1 to 0 when threat == "extinct" (so we believe that RL data is correct, altough checking in GBIF, records of these spp in these countries are found recently in some cases).

```{r}
redlist_phenobs_final_occ <- redlist_phenobs_final_occ %>%
  mutate(
    occurrence = case_when(
      threat == "extinct" ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ occurrence
    )
  )
```

# Calculate % endangerment

Proportion of countries where the species is endangered, and proportion of range where species is endangered.

Add info on country areas:

```{r}
world <- ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

countries_area <- world %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(8857) %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.))/1e6) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(
    country = iso_a3,
    area_km2
  )

extra_codes <- tibble::tribble(
  ~country, ~country_ref,
  "FRA", "France",
  "NOR", "Norway",
  "GLP", "Guadeloupe",
  "MTQ", "Martinique",
  "MYT", "Mayotte",
  "REU", "Reunion",
  "GUF", "French Guiana",
  "GIB", "Gibraltar",
  "SJM", "Svalbard and Jan Mayen",
  "TKL", "Tokelau",
  "UMI", "United States Minor Outlying Islands"
)

extra_area <- extra_codes %>%
  left_join(
    world %>%
      select(admin, geometry),
    by = c("country_ref" = "admin")
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(8857) %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.))/1e6) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(country, area_km2)

countries_area <- bind_rows(countries_area, extra_area)

countries_area <- countries_area %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      country = c("KOS", "XKX"),
      area_km2 = 10887
    )
  )

redlist_phenobs_final_occ <- redlist_phenobs_final_occ %>%
  left_join(countries_area)
```

```{r}
perc_endangerment <- redlist_phenobs_final_occ %>%
  filter(occurrence > 0) %>%  # only countries where species is present
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_countries = n_distinct(country),
    threatened_countries = sum(threat == "threatened"),

    perc_endangerment =
      (threatened_countries / total_countries) * 100,

    total_area = sum(area_km2),

    threatened_area =
      sum(area_km2[threat == "threatened"]),

    perc_endangered_range =
      (threatened_area / total_area) * 100,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_endangerment = perc_endangerment / 100,
    prop_endangered_range = perc_endangered_range / 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(species)
```

```{r}
hist(perc_endangerment$prop_endangerment)
hist(perc_endangerment$prop_endangered_range) # Those where > 0.2 are threatened in Russia
# Think about removing Russia!
```

# Data prep sensitivity data

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
slopes_all_resolved <- slopes_all_resolved %>%
  # Remove unneeded cols
  select(-Species, -n_gardens, -temp_min, -temp_max, -temp_mean, -n_data) %>%
  # Add variable for "sens" vs "not-sens"
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
      select(name_res, starts_with("mean_"), starts_with("slope_var"),

```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sens_per_endanger_stress <- sens_per_endanger %>%
  left_join(stress_resolved, by = c("species" = "name_res")) %>%

```

## Sensitivity + % endangerment + Ellenberg tendency of change

Deal with non-numeric values in indicator values

Columns OEK_L - OEK_S and HAEUF_AE_change

```{r}
ellenberg <- ellenberg %>%
  mutate(across(OEK_L:OEK_S, ~ parse_number(.)))
```

Join with sens_per_endanger:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
sens_per_endanger_stress_ell <- sens_per_endanger_stress %>%
  left_join(ellenberg_resolved %>%
              select(name_res, HAEUF_AE_change) %>%
              rename(change = HAEUF_AE_change) %>%
              group_by(name_res) %>%
              # For duplicates, get the mean
              summarise(change = as.integer(mean(change, na.rm = TRUE)),
                        .groups = "drop"), 
            by = c("species" = "name_res"))
```

# Models endangerment ~ sensitivity 

Filtering slope_var < 50 - clearer patterns.

Binomial models with cbind(threatened_countries, total_countries - threatened_countries).

Added prediction plots only for models with any significant effects.

## Sensitive or not

```{r}
stage_names <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  distinct(stage) %>%
  pull(stage)

mod_sens_01 <- sens_endanger %>%
  filter(slope_var < 50) %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  group_map(~ glmmTMB(cbind(threatened_countries, 
                        total_countries - threatened_countries) ~ sens_01, 
                   data = .x, 
                  # Use betabinomial because of overdispersion with binomial
                  family = betabinomial())) %>%
  setNames(stage_names)

map_df(mod_sens_01, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
plot(ggpredict(mod_sens_01$FlPeak))
```

## Sensitivity sign

```{r}
sens_endanger <- sens_endanger %>%
  mutate(sens_sign = factor(case_when(
    mean_slope > 0 ~ "positive",
    mean_slope < 0 ~ "negative",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )))
```

```{r}
mod_sens_sign <- sens_endanger %>%

  group_map(~ glmmTMB(cbind(threatened_countries, 
                        total_countries - threatened_countries) ~ sens_sign, 
                      data = .x, family = betabinomial())) %>%
  setNames(stage_names)

map_df(mod_sens_sign, tidy, .id = "stage") %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) %>% print(n = 50)
```


# Models Ellenberg tendency of change (declining / not) ~ sensitivity

Declining species defined as those with a trend index <= 3 (as in Ozinga et al. 2009).

We create a new variable "decline", which is 1 if trend index <= 3, and 0 otherwise.

```{r}
sens_endanger_stress_ell <- sens_endanger_stress_ell %>%
  mutate(decline = ifelse(is.na(change), NA, ifelse(change <= 3, 1, 0)))
```

# PCA

```{r}
pca_phen <- prcomp(sens_per_endanger %>% 
                     select(starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>%
                     drop_na(), 
                   center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
```

```{r}
scores <- as.data.frame(pca_phen$x) %>%
  mutate(species = (sens_per_endanger %>%
                      select(species, starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>%
                      drop_na())$species) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(abs(PC1) > quantile(abs(PC1), 0.95) |
                          abs(PC2) > quantile(abs(PC2), 0.95),
                        species, ""))
```

```{r}
# Variable loadings for arrows
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_phen$rotation) %>%
  mutate(variable = rownames(.)) %>%
  # Remove mean_slope from variable names
  mutate(variable = gsub("mean_slope_", "", variable))

ggplot(scores %>%
         left_join(
           sens_per_endanger %>% 
             select(species, prop_endangerment)
           ), 
       aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, color = "steelblue"
             ) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, max.overlaps = 15) +
  geom_segment(data = loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1*3, yend = PC2*3),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "darkred") +
  geom_text_repel(data = loadings,
                  aes(x = PC1*3, y = PC2*3, label = variable),
                  color = "red3", size = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2")
```

```{r}
plot(pca_phen)
```

## Clustering

```{r}
dist_pcs <- dist(scores %>%
                   select(PC1, PC2, PC3, PC4), 
                 method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dist_pcs, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
scores$cluster <- factor(cutree(hc, k = 3))
ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.68) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Plot with clusters

```{r}
ggplot(
  scores %>%
    left_join(
      sens_per_endanger %>% 
        select(species, prop_endangerment),
      by = "species"
    ),
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = cluster)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  #geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, max.overlaps = 15) +
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * 3, yend = PC2 * 3),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = PC1 * 4, y = PC2 * 4, label = variable),
    color = "black",
    size = 4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    nudge_x = 0.1* sign(loadings$PC1),
    nudge_y = 0.1 * sign(loadings$PC2),
    box.padding = 0.2,      # distance around text box
    point.padding = 0.2,    # distance from arrows/points
    max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  #stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.68) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.8))
```

# RDA effect of endangerment

## Endangered or not

```{r}
rda_trait_endanger <- rda(
  sens_per_endanger %>% select(starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>% drop_na() ~ 
    (sens_per_endanger %>%
       mutate(endangerment = factor(
         ifelse(prop_endangerment == 0, 0, 1)))%>% drop_na())$endangerment,
  data = sens_per_endanger
  )
anova(rda_trait_endanger, permutations = 999)
anova(rda_trait_endanger, by = "axis", permutations = 999)
RsquareAdj(rda_trait_endanger)
```

## Proportion of endangerment

```{r}
rda_trait_endanger_prop <- rda(
  sens_per_endanger %>% select(starts_with("mean_slope_")) %>% drop_na() ~ 
    (sens_per_endanger%>% drop_na())$prop_endangerment,
  data = sens_per_endanger
  )
anova(rda_trait_endanger_prop, permutations = 999)
anova(rda_trait_endanger_prop, by = "axis", permutations = 999)
RsquareAdj(rda_trait_endanger_prop)
```
